'FX Senshi Kurumi-chan' Unveils Additional Staff, Opening Theme, Main Promo
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Demunyan and Daisuki Tansan's FX Senshi Kurumi-chan (FX Fighter Kurumi-chan) manga unveiled additional staff, the opening theme, and the main promotional video on Monday. The anime will premiere on October 1 at 9.30 p.m. on AT-X, followed by Tokyo MX, BS11, and Kansai TV. CloverWorks Produces New 'Pokemon: Wildcard' Movie for 2027
The Pokemon Company announced a new anime film titled Pokemon: Wildcard during the Pokemon World Championships 2026 in San Francisco on Monday, revealing the main staff, announcement visual, and promotional video. The first new film in the Pokemon franchise in seven years is scheduled to premiere in 2027. Katsuhiko Kitada (The First Slam Dunk episode director) is directing the film at CloverWorks. Manga '8-gatsu 31-nichi no Long Summer' Gets TV Anime, Live-Action Adaptation
The official X account for Ikkado Itou's 8-gatsu 31-nichi no Long Summer (The Long Summer of August 31) manga announced a television anime adaptation and live-action television drama on Monday, revealing an ultra teaser visual (pictured). Shaft, the animation studio known for Mahou Shoujo Madoka★Magica (Puella Magi Madoka Magica) and Monogatari series, is producing the anime series.
